contents.name: 5.1 Uniformly non-primitive graphs
contents.reason: This section is stated for general \Delta-graphs and prime clans. The graph-only page keeps only the undirected cograph specialization and leaves the full clan-language theory to the already-recorded owner-decision gap around strong modules and special quotients.

contents.name: Lemma 5.1
contents.reason: The quotient and subgraph closure of uniform non-primitivity is part of the wider \Delta-graph clan theory. This page works with undirected cographs directly and does not need to reopen the general quotient formalism.

contents.name: Lemma 5.2
contents.reason: The three-way equivalence is again stated for arbitrary \Delta-graphs and clans. Its graph-theoretic cograph specialization is harvested separately from Exercise 5.3, which is the form this page actually needs.

contents.name: Remark 5.1
contents.reason: The proper-prime-clan refinement belongs with strong-module and special-quotient theory, which the current plan still has no page to hold.

contents.name: Exercise 5.1
contents.reason: Its clause (v) is stated in the special-quotient language that the current plan still routes away from this graph-only page, so carrying the whole five-way \Delta-graph equivalence here would overshoot the decided scope.
